sentences.text: This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.22/2023 of Police Station Gorakhpur,
District Jabalpur for commission of offence punishable under Section 363, 376(2)(n), 506, 368, 34 of the IPC and Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
They are in detention since 16.01.2023.
As per prosecution story on 09.01.2023, 17 years old prosecutrix lodged FIR alleging that she has studied upto Class-IX and has developed her friendship with accused through one other friend.
On 25.11.2021 Himanshu came to her house at 7:45 PM from his bike and told that he likes her and asked to go along with him.
He took her to his house at Christian Mohalla, Gorakhpur and since then she was residing with Himanshu at ground floor of the house.
Sometimes, his sister Shrishti used to meet her.
Himanshu was living with her and in this period he established physical relations with her several times.
He used to threaten her that if she left him he will eliminate her entire family.
FIR was registered.

In her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.PC she along with aforesaid allegations also alleged that Himanshu's parents along with his sister and brother used to live at first floor of the same house.
Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that applicants have not committed any offence.
They are innocent.
They have been falsely implicated.
There are no allegations against them about kidnapping or forcibly taking girl.
There is no allegation against them that they committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault/rape or facilitated commission of the same.
Only because they are parents of the main accused they have been maliciously enroped in the said crime.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicants be released on bail pending the trial.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicants.

Having taken into consideration the entirety of facts and total allegations against the present applicants who are the parents of the main accused, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre trial detention of the applicants is not warranted.
Consequently, this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicants, stands allowed.

I t is directed that applicants - Manoj Kumar Katariya and Smt. Sushila be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for their regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that they shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
They shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
